import subprocess,re
s=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--no-ext-diff'],text=True)
pats=[r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])sk-(?:proj-|or-v1-)?[A-Za-z0-9_-]{32,}',r'gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}',r'-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----']
counts=[len(re.findall(p,s)) for p in pats]
print({'secret_pattern_counts':counts})
raise SystemExit(any(counts))
PY
